note: Battle engine data (js/battle.js · PROGRESS §14). cards = the skill of each card as numbers the engine runs (a card not here fights with ATK / HP only: 'Skill not simulated yet'). support = what a support does in a fight that needs a hit / a turn (its value = C.supValAt at the support slot's rarity; buffs with no condition are already in js/deckbuff.js). traits = the trait lines that need a fight (the ×damage / ×HP are in js/deckbuff.js). groups = card ids of a group a skill names (guess = not checked in the game yet). Fields: PROGRESS §14 'field battle'. todo = the card's / support's sentences the engine can't fight with yet (the result says 'Partly simulated'). A support written as { … } = fields like a card's, merged into the supported card ('$n' = its n-th value). The cards not on the site yet (data/pending) and the supports were written by tools/battle_skills.py (2026-11-05).
